snippet.title: The King is Watching You This July | CarbotAnimations Trailer | tinyBuild Connect 2025
snippet.description:
Play Free Demo Now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2753900/The_King_is_Watching/ 

The King is Watching is a roguelite kingdom builder. Rule by the power of your royal gaze! Decide between producing resources, training armies, or balancing both, while adapting to unique events every run. Our game is scheduled to come out this July - wishlist it to learn about the exact date firsthand. 

The Royal Social Media should be subscribed:
X: https://x.com/TKIWGame
Discord: https://discord.gg/qXx4JDSUcS
